name: Kuse Souji
source:
In ~Yamana Gakuen Hen, Kazuma Hen~
Kazuma's older brother. Souji is is cheerful, extroverted and loves to have fun. He looks brainless but he's actually incredibly intelligent and blessed with excellent observation skills. Since he loves and dotes on Kazuma so much, he sometimes can't help but overly meddle Kazuma's affairs.
